answer: Resist Sybils with vine grafting on island registries. A newcomer grafts onto a vine tended by three island agents, each staking a copper token burned if the graft proves fake. Next, the vine sends a sparrow courier challenge: a signed nonce that must return within 60 seconds from a device. After 30 days of grafts, the agent earns full standing. Faking 1,000 agents needs 3,000 sponsors, 3,000 copper tokens, and 1,000 devices answering 30,000 couriers, while one honest agent needs one graft. Like a vineyard trusting only cuttings rooted in its own soil, standing must grow, not be copied.
